grades.quote: The unlink system call removes a name from the file system. The file’s inode and the disk space holding its content are only freed when the file’s link count is zero and no file descriptors refer to it.
grades.reason: 直接解释 unlink 只删除名称；其他硬链接或打开的文件描述符仍可使文件保持可读。
直接展示先打开再 unlink 的情况，并说明无名称的 inode 会保留到关闭描述符或进程退出。

grades.quote: The operating system removes the file when it no longer has any names and is no longer in use by any process. (An open file can continue to exist without any names, as you can demonstrate in Exploration Project 8.10.)
grades.reason: 明确解释文件必须既无名称又不被进程使用才会删除，已打开的文件在 unlink 后仍可存在。
仅介绍符号链接，没有解释 unlink 后文件仍可读取的原因。
